ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(Measure__c , "Complimentary Seat"), OR( ISBLANK(TEXT(Routes__c)), ISBLANK(TEXT(Seat__c)), ISBLANK(TEXT(Number_of_pax_Complimentary_Seat__c)), ISBLANK(Pax_Name_Complimentary_Seat__c) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: When Measure = Complimentary Seat, Routes / Seat / Number of pax / Pax Name are all required.
